Pca der finder variance
og RDA med metadata

```{r}
ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(pylsq, function(x) x / sum(x))
otu_rel <- as(otu_table(ps_rel), "matrix") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
meta_rel <- as(sample_data(ps_rel), "matrix") %>% as.data.frame()
tax_rel <- as(tax_table(ps_rel), "matrix") %>% as.data.frame()

```


```{r}
dat_rel <- otu_rel %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to = "taxon", values_to = "rel_abund") %>%
  left_join(meta_rel %>% as("data.frame") %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id") %>%
  left_join(tax_rel %>% rownames_to_column("taxon"), by = "taxon")
```


Wilcoxon rank sum
```{r}
wilcox_results <- dat_rel %>%
  group_by(taxon, Genus, Species) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = wilcox.test(
      rel_abund ~ Disease.MESH.ID,
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value,

    mean_D003924 = mean(
      rel_abund[Disease.MESH.ID == "D003924"]
    ),

    mean_D006262 = mean(
      rel_abund[Disease.MESH.ID == "D006262"]
    ),

    log2_fc = log2(
      (mean_D003924 + 1e-6) /
      (mean_D006262 + 1e-6)
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    q_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  )
```



```{r}
wilcox_D006262_enriched <- wilcox_results %>%
  select(
    taxon,
    Genus,
    Species,
    mean_D003924,
    mean_D006262,
    log2_fc,
    p_value,
    q_value
  ) %>%
  arrange(log2_fc) %>%
  head(10)
```






```{r}
wilcox_results %>%
  mutate(
    neg_log10_q = -log10(q_value),
    direction = case_when(
      q_value < 0.05 & log2_fc > 0 ~ "D003924-enriched",
      q_value < 0.05 & log2_fc < 0 ~ "D006262-enriched",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2_fc,
             y = neg_log10_q,
             color = direction)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "D003924-enriched" = "#E74C3C",
      "D006262-enriched" = "#3498DB",
      "Not significant" = "grey60"
    )
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Log2 fold change (D003924 vs D006262)",
    y = "-log10(q-value)",
    color = NULL,
    title = "Differential abundance between Disease.MESH.ID groups"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```



```{r}
bind_rows(
  wilcox_results %>%
    filter(q_value < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(log2_fc) %>%
    head(10),

  wilcox_results %>%
    filter(q_value < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(-log2_fc) %>%
    head(10)
) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    label = Species,
    direction = ifelse(
      log2_fc > 0,
      "D003924-enriched",
      "D006262-enriched"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = reorder(label, -q_value),
      y = log2_fc,
      fill = direction
    )
  ) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "D003924-enriched" = "#E74C3C",
      "D006262-enriched" = "#3498DB"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Log2 fold change (D003924 vs D006262)",
    fill = NULL,
    title = "Top differentially abundant species"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```



```{r}
glm_disease_results <- dat_rel %>%
  group_by(taxon, Genus, Species) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    fit <- glm(
      log10(rel_abund + 1e-6) ~ Disease.MESH.ID,
      data = .x,
      family = gaussian()
    )

    broom::tidy(fit)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(grepl("Disease.MESH.ID", term)) %>%
  mutate(
    q_value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    fold_change = 10^estimate
  )
```




```{r}
glm_D006262_enriched <- glm_disease_results %>%
  select(
    taxon,
    Genus,
    Species,
    estimate,
    fold_change,
    std.error,
    statistic,
    p.value,
    q_value
  ) %>%
  arrange(fold_change) %>%
  head(10)

glm_D006262_enriched
```
